purpose: Production-shaped SAM 3.1 multi-object preprocessor validation before gateway integration.

storage_design.scene: raw input bytes in shared artifact Volume
storage_design.candidate_masks: single numpy.packbits masks.bin per selection plus result.json
storage_design.materialization: CPU-only selected mask -> mask.png + canonical RGBA PNG

fpn_adapter_validation.reason: HF SAM 3.1 config/checkpoint exposes three detector FPN levels. The generic image builder creates four then discards the fourth with scalp=1.
fpn_adapter_validation.change: construct on CPU; remove unused fourth conv before checkpoint load; set scalp=0; then load checkpoint and move to CUDA

validated_contract.segment: image bytes + text concept -> scene_id + selection_id + multiple bbox/score candidates + packed masks
validated_contract.refine: scene_id + text concept + 1..16 normalized positive/negative boxes -> refined candidates
validated_contract.materialize: scene_id + selection_id + candidate_id -> selected mask + canonical RGBA on CPU

notes: Cold wall time includes Modal container startup, Python imports, model construction, and first prompt-path warm-up; do not compare it directly to warm prompt latency.
The single-entry scene cache is an optimization only. Evicted scenes recover from raw bytes in the shared Volume and re-encode in about 47 ms once the model is warm.
Candidate masks are bit-packed to avoid eagerly encoding many PNG/RGBA artifacts before the user chooses an object.
The canonical output check verifies file structure and alpha range, not segmentation accuracy against human ground truth.
The static-image SAM 3.1 path uses the detector portion of a multiplex/video checkpoint; the feature branch remains isolated until downstream integration is explicitly chosen.
